BiblicalUsage: Gabhuth is pride, the loftiness of men that God promises to bow down. The lofty looks of man shall be humbled in Isaiah 2:11, and the loftiness of men shall be made low in Isaiah 2:17, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day. The word appears only in these two verses, and both carry the same sentence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the day is coming when every high look falls; Isaiah says it twice because it needs saying twice: the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day, and I hold that to bow now is better than to be bowed then.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
